(ja)༄༅/ /byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i dpal rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i dpal rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rta mgrin nag po bsgrub par 'dod pas/ dang po stan bde bar 'dug nas/ skyabs 'gro lan gsum byas te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rta mgrin bsgom snyam du sems bskyed/ rang nyid rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin gyi dbu'i cha la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes brjod/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ yan lag bdun pa lan gsum bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog de rnams rta mgrin gyi skur gyur/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri bskal pa'i me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa na nad gdon sreg par byed pa'i me yi phung po rab tu 'bar ba bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal gyi mche ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yas su gtsigs shing*/ g.yon du rngam pa/ sma ra dang dbu skra gyen du 'bar zhing 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ spyi bo nas rta mgo ljang gur thon pa'i rta skad kyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/

klu rgyal rigs dkar pos dbur brgyan cing*/ bram ze'i rigs ser pos mgul rgyan/ rje'u rigs ser pos phyag gdub/ gdol rigs nag pos ga shal/ dmangs rigs ser khras zhabs gdub byas pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal sogs dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ khro gnyer shin tu bsdus shing shin tu 'jigs par byed pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sku lus sbom la thung ba/ ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs la/ mchod bstod bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang*/ mchod pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ hūm̐/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku// sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥdamar po'i tha mar rtsa sngags kyis g.yon skor du bskor te gnas pa las/ rtsa sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer dang bcas pa zhal nas thon phrin las bsgrubs/

tshur 'dus thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim par bsam zhing sngags bzla bar bya'o// hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sarba tsit+ta kā la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha rbad rbud gtubs/ shag ha nan rbad rbud gtubs/ gṛh+ṇa rā dza ya rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa ci nus bzlas so// de nas mchod bstod byas te spyod lam la 'jug go /bsnyen tshad ni/ 'bum phrag gcig gam bzhi'am/ brgyad la sogs pa bzla bar bya'o// de nas thun mtshams su gtor ma btang bar 'dod na/ gtor ma sha khrag la sogs pas brgyan par byas la/ a mṛ tas bgegs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas thod pa'i nang du dam rdzas phun sum tshogs pas gang bar bsams la yi ge gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi steng ngam/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐/ gnyis med rang byung dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// brjod med chos nyid don las ma g.yos kyang*// dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i don slad du// brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'jig rten rnal 'byor dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan steng gi /ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rngam brjid ngar dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku// sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes brjod de byon par bsam/ de nas zhabs bsil/ mchod yon phul nas ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/

ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod pa lngas mchod la/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo las// chos nyid mi 'gyur rta mchog rol pa'i sku// gsung mchog rta skad 'tsher bas gdug pa 'dul// dbyer med lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'gyur med rtogs pas sku mdog nag /shes rab ral gri 'phyar bas 'khor ba gcod// g.yon na me phung bsnams pas bdud rnams sreg /'jigs byed drag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// srid gsum sreg mdzad spyan gsum me phung 'phro// smin ma glog stong ma rig mun pa 'joms// gshin rje khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rab tu gtsigs// rnam thar brgyad ldan dpal gyi chas brgyad gsol// zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad pas bdud rnams 'joms// dbang chen khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gag med pad+ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// dbyer med brtse ba'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// dam rdzas 'bar ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam brgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab// dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo// badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu ste gtor ma'i rim pa'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i las tshogs la lnga ste/ dang po nad pa gso ba ni/ rang rta mgrin ye shes kyi me phung rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas par bsgom/ sa bdag klu gnyan rnams bskal pa'i me la sbrang bu mi gnas pa bzhin du thul thul sreg par bsams la rtsa sngags kyi gsham du/ sarba nā ga tsit+ta breg shag mā ra ya thum rbad/ ces pa btags la brgya bzlas so// gnyis pa steng gdon gzir ba ni/ rang rta mgrin du bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas gdon gyi snying dkar nag gi mtshams nas bzung la sngags 'dis gzir te/
e hu ra thum dza/

'phrog byed 'bru bzhi/ trig nan mā ra ya rbad/ gzir byed 'bru bzhi/ gsod byed 'bru bzhi/ gnod ma mo thams cad 'dus pa'i snying po/ byed sarba tsit+ta gtubs/ srog gzir rbud nan/ tri phu hrī dpe dag pa gcig la/ hrīḥphyung hrī shag mā ra ya rbad/ ces snang*/ shag rbad rbad/ ces pa rtsa sngags la btags la bzlas so// gsum pa lus srung ba ni/ sarba dpe gcig la/ sa ha ga ha la ha la tsa ma ri phyung*/ hrīḥshag mā ra ya rbad/ ces snang*/ nā ga ha la ha la/ tsi ma tri phyug tri shag mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa rang gi dri chu la mang du bzlas te/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams te 'thungs pas rtsa dang rtsa phran thams cad du song bas nad gdon thams cad nyi mas mun pa sel ba bzhin sngon dmar du byas nas 'thon par bsam/ de nas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad hūm̐ gis gtams par bsam mo// bzhi pa ser ba srung ba ni/ ser ba'i snying po dz+wa la raṃ rbad zlog bh+yoḥ zhes pa rtsa sngags kyi sham bur btags la/ yungs kar rgyal po dang*/ thal chen la mang du bzlas la g.yas pa'i ral gri me 'bar bas sprin gshags par bsam/ g.yon gyi mes bsregs par bsam/ de nas thun 'phangs pas bcad par bsam mo// lnga pa phyir zlog pa ni/ dmar gtor gcig bshams nas de dgra bo'i sha khrag tu bsams la rta mgrin gyi zhal du bstab bo// de nas/ rbad ta ya rbad ta ya lo ka rbad ta ya phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ha/ zlog zlog ces pa rtsa sngags la btags pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ thebs ldog brtsi la zor du 'phang ngo*// byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa rdzogs so// ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal khru gang pa la/ ba byung lngas byugs pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i dbus su rta mgrin gyi sku dang sgrub pa'i chos dang*/

seng ldeng gi phur pa ste/ de ltar sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mthar mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gcig bsham mo// de nas slob dpon khrus byas te/ mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgoms la bzlas pa cung zad byas te/ maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu'i steng du yang rta mgrin bskyed chog byas la mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul lo// de nas slob ma khrus byas te phyag 'tshal/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ khyed rnams dpal rta mgrin gyi dbang zhu ba de tshe 'di'i nad zhi ba dang*/ gdon zhi ba dang*/ phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba ni ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rta mgrin gyi rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu snyam pa mdzod la maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul mdzod byas la tshar ba dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba btab/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor bar bzhugs pa'i spyan snga nas yar la yan lag bdun pa phul bar bsams la/ 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad par zhu/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar lan gsum brjod du gzhug de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dpal rta mgrin bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ji srid dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/

khro bo'i rgyal po yi dam du bzung ba 'tshal gyi/ slob dpon gyis dpal rta mgrin bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa ni sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas kyi sdig sgrib bag chags/ snang ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus mthing nag de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru me swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor me tog re bzhag la/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar nag de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dpal rta mgrin sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhes pa nas/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa la cung zad cig mchod la/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// dpal rta mgrin 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'di la dbang skur cig /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// rta mgrin go 'phang ma thob bar// yi dam lha ru mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ rta mgrin khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas mar la thim pa'i mos par mdzod/ de gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyi ye shes pa bstim pa bya ba yin/

de ltar thim pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed la/ de'i spyi bor bris sku bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dbang*// gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni// bdud dang nyon mongs 'joms par mdzad// de ring khyed la sbyin par bya// rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol/ yang pusti spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi dbang*// gang gis bklag pa tsam gyis ni// dngos grub rnam gnyis thob 'gyur bar// de ring khyed la sbyin par bya// rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas lung gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rta mgrin du gsal ba'i snying ga'i dkyil du yi ge hrīḥdamar nag gcig sgoms mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi rta mgrin la phog pas de'i thugs rgyud bskul/ rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba chu las chu bur brdol ba bzhin thol thol byung*/ rta mgrin gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang der bsgoms pa'i zhal du zhugs/ hrīḥdamar nag gi mtha' skor du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha sogs rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis rjes zlos byed du gzhug de nas slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// zhes pa nas/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pa'i bar brjod la me tog gtor ba ni bzlas pa'i lung ngo*// de rjes ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/

sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi dbang*// gang gis bcangs pa tsam gyis ni// bdud dang log lta 'joms par byed// de ring khyed la sbyin par bya// rtsa sngags dang*/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas seng ldeng gi phur pa sgril zhing gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las dbang*// gang gis bsgril ba tsam gyis ni// bdud dang log lta gsod par byed// de ring khyed la sbyin par bya// rtsa sngags dang*/ karma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ sku gsung thugs dang phrin las kyi dbang ngo*// de nas gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du gtor ma 'di ni tha mal pa'i gtor ma ma yin par yi ge hrīḥdamar nag las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gtor ma de nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas/ thugs ka'i stod du hrīḥdamar nag ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed la/ thugs ka'i hrīḥdang slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas po ta la nas/ dpal rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dril bu gsil zhing*/ hūm̐/ gnyis med rang byung dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// sogs kyis spyan drangs la bstim/ dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ mchod pas mchod/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo nyid// ces pa nas/ rnal 'byor tshe yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol// zhes pas bstod cing gsol ba btab/ gtor ma'i dpal 'bar sbar la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa/ sarba tsit+ta kā la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha rbad rbud gtubs/ shag ha nan/ rbad rbud gtubs/

gṛh+ṇa rā dza ya rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ba liṃ ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das shrī ha ya grī was byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis byin gyis= zhang skyi tsha 'od chen gyis= zhes pa nas/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin pa'i bar gyis/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur du gsol/ 'di rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'di rnams kyi nad dang gdon bgegs bar gcod thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dbang phyug la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzhan yang las ngan sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dpal rta mgrin rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ces pas phrin las bcol/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas sogs brjod/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ tsa ka li la brtan bzhugs bya/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ smon lam ci shes gang rigs btab la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi lag len dang bcas pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// rta mgrin bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang 'dra/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rta mgrin bsgom par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis rta mgrin du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod de/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems hrīḥdamar nag de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log 'dren steng gdon dang 'og gdon la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad sbyangs/ rta mgrin gyi go 'phang la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus te hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas nad gdon sreg pa'i me'i phung po rab tu 'bar ba bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal mche ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs yod pa gtsigs shing*/ g.yon du rngam pa/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar zhing 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ spyi bo nas rta mgo sngo ljang thon zhing rta skad kyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ klu rgyal rigs dkar pos dbur brgyan pa/ bram ze'i rigs dmar pos mgul pa brgyan pa/ rje'u rigs ser pos phyag gdub/ gdol pa'i rigs nag pos ga shal/ dmangs rigs ser pos zhabs gdub byas pa/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal la sogs pa dpa' bo'i chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa khro gnyer shin tu gnyer zhing*/ rab tu 'jigs par byed pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sku lus sbom la thung ba/ ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ mchod pa gong ltar bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shri hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams bsgom mo// rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥ'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du bskor ba/ de dag las 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log 'dren/ steng gdon gza' dang*/ 'og gdon klu dang*/ bar gdon btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par zhal nas 'thon te thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim par bsam/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sarba tsit+ta kā la me dpung gtubs/

ha ha rbad rbud gtubs/ shag ha nan rbad rbud gtubs/ gṛh+ṇa rā dza rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log 'dren sogs 'byung po mi ma yin pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang*/ myur du bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bcom ldan rta mgrin 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yis sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo ba dang smon lam ci shes bya zhing*/ bsnyen pa byed na 'bum phrag bzhi bzla'o// de'i rjes su gtor ma 'bul na gtor ma gcig sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams la chu gtsang mas bran/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ gnyis med rang byung dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// brjod med chos nyid don las ma g.yos kyang*/ dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i don slad du// brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐/ 'jig rten rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khri steng na// ru dra zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rngam brjid ngar dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/

gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku// sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes byon par bsam/ oṃ ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo las// chos nyid mi 'gyur rta mchog rol pa'i sku// gsung mchog rta skad 'tsher bas 'gro ba 'dul// dbyer med lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dam rdzas 'bar ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin sogs nas byin gyis brlabatu gsol/ snga ma ltar brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la bsngo ba dang bkra shis gang shes bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng ngam mdun du rta mgrin gyi sku/ g.yas su pusti/ rgyab tu rdo rje/ g.yon du phur bu rnams ci mdzes bshams ba'i mthar/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod gtor ma/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril me tog sogs sta gon bya/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin rlabs/

bdag bskyed sgom bzlas/ tshom bu'i lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa/ mchod bstod/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ bzlas pa bya ba rnams bdag mdun gyi khyad par ma 'dzol bar grub rjes/ slob ma rnams khrus byas te gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab/ de la 'dir mngon spyod kyi rigs su gtogs pa/ de la du ma zhig yod pa'i nang nas rta mgrin yin/ de la 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa la brten nas bla med ltar du bkral ba rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa la jo bo lugs zhes grags pa yin/ yang rta mgrin nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'am lcags ral can zhes yongs su grags pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa la zla rgyal lugs zhes zer ba yin/ yang rgyud thams cad kyi snying po dang*/ rtog pa bdun pa la brten nas slob dpon chen po a bha yas sgrub thabs rgya mtshor bshad pa'i rta mgrin dmar po phyag gnyis pa dang*/ phyag brgyad pa la sogs pa du ma dang*/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas gsungs pa rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad zlog par byed pa la sngar byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gzigs pa'i bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin nag po'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba rnams su yod pa las/ dang po slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub zin nas khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ rjes su gnang ba'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po la maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams dgos pa yin pas/ slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ phyag me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs nas zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rta mgrin la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas shog ces kha bskangs nas/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin yi dam du 'dzin par 'tshal gyi/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pa dang bcas pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyi sku can du gsal ba la de lta bu dngos yin snyam pa'i sems kyis gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa bskal pa'i me lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ khro bo dang khro mo mdun bskyed dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/

thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas kyang reg pa tsam gyis 'tshig par byed pa'i me stag dmar phrom phrom 'phro ba dang bcas pa lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu'i tshogs 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnam smin gdos bcas kyis bsdus pa'i sha khrag gi phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ khyad par du nad gdon bgegs dang log 'dren steng gdon dang 'og gdon la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad bya sgro mes sreg pa bzhin gzhob thul gyis bsregs shing sbyangs te/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par mos/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du lam gyis gsal btab ste/ de la slob dpon gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ slob dpon la khyed rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu dngos yin snyam pa'i yid kyis mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs nas bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi sku dpag tu med par spyan drangs te khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang*/ de 'dra ba'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam tshad med grangs med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug la sogs pa na mar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis me tog spyi bor bzhag ste/ rta mgrin 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// rta mgrin 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'di la dbang skur cig /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// rta mgrin go 'phang ma thob par// yi dam lha ru mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/

brtan par byas shing byin gyis rlob par mos/ des gzhi dgod pa yin/ de la brten nas rjes gnang dngos la/ sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pas/ dpal rta mgrin gyi sku khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ lus kyi bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud dang nyon mongs pa thams cad tshar bcad de/ rta mgrin gyi sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs te/ sku'i rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dbang*// gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni// bdud dang nyon mongs 'joms par byed// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyi skur byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pas glegs bam khyed rang gi mgrin par gtugs te/ ngag la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud dang nyon mongs pa thams cad sbyangs te/ rta mgrin gyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa ngag la zhugs te gsung gi rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi dbang*// gang gis bklags pa tsam gyis ni// dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par 'gyur// de ring sogs nas grī wa wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar nag gcig gsal btab ste/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung ste/ zhal nas thon khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la thim zhing*/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib/

steng gdon dang 'og gdon la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad sbyangs par mos pa byas nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ hrīḥpad+mā sogs bzlas la/ dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos shing*/ slob mas me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs nas/ bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// ces gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ 'di la 'go bar mdzod/ rdo rje slob ma 'di'i rgyud la bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi gsang sngags kyi nus mthu thams cad 'jug par gyur cig des gsung gi rjes gnang thob ces sogs gang gi ngo sprod 'don pa bsgyur/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa khyed rang gi snying gar gtugs te mthar phyag g.yas su byin pas sems la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad de rta mgrin gyi thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa sems la zhugs te/ thugs kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi dbang*// gang gis bcangs pa tsam gyis ni// bdud dang log lta 'joms par byed// de ring sogs nas grī wa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ thugs kyi rjes gnang thob ces sogs ngo sprod 'don pa bsgyur/ phrin las kyi rjes gnang gi slad du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pas phur pa khyed rang gi phyag tu byin te/ byed las la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad de/ rta mgrin gyi phrin las kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa khyed rnams kyi byed las la zhugs te phrin las kyi/ phrin las dbang= gang gis bsgril ba tsam gyis ni// bdud dang dgra bgegs gsod par byed// de ring sogs nas grī wa karma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

des phrin las kyi rjes gnang thob/ byed las kyi bar chad zhi bar byas/ byed las bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyi phrin las su byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ yon tan gyi rjes su gnang ba'am gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma 'di bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin du mos pa byas te/ de'i steng na rtsa ba'i bla ma nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i mthar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas yod par mos pa byas te/ de slob dpon gyis khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag nas bka' bsgos par mos pa mdzod/ mtshan mo yin na gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs/ nyin mo mi dgos/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa ba liṃ ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zhang skye tsha 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar ba/ zhang lo tsā ba/ zhang byang rin/ dpal rgyal ba grub/ chos rje 'dzin pa/ chos rje spang sgang pa/ sgrub pa po rin chen brtson 'grus/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ kha phyar ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ rje btsun lha mchog seng ge/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge la sogs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dang bcas pas rdo rje slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la rtag tu 'bral ba med par bzhugs nas/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi 'gal rkyen steng gdon gza' dang drang srong gi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/

mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs nas rang dang gzhan gyi don thogs pa med par grub pa dang*/ mthar bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyi go 'phang bde blag tu thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod pas gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba de las bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa zhig chad de khyed rang gi spyi bor thim par mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub/ gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ tshom bu'i lha la mchod bstod bzod gsol byas la/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te bkra shis dang dga' ston bya'o// 'di'i sgo nas nad pa gso ba/ steng gdon gzir ba/ lus srung ba/ ser ba srung ba/ phyir zlog rnams yi ge rnying pa las rtogs par bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge pa'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa brang ti'i dge slong ga ga na shrī bha dras bla ma'i gsung rgyun cung zad zin pa dang phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rnams brjed pas 'jigs nas dran gsor e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod thar pa rtser sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
